033/**
034 * NotifyEvent $eventHandle <params> 
035 * 
036 */
037public class Commission extends BaseCommandPlugin {
038        
039        public static RepLevel COMMISSION_REQ = RepLevel.FAVORABLE;
040        
041        protected CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet;
042        protected SectorEntityToken entity;
043        protected FactionAPI playerFaction;
044        protected FactionAPI entityFaction;
045        protected TextPanelAPI text;
046        protected OptionPanelAPI options;
047        protected CargoAPI playerCargo;
048        protected MemoryAPI memory;
049        protected InteractionDialogAPI dialog;
050        protected Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap;
051        protected PersonAPI person;
052        protected FactionAPI faction;
053
054        protected boolean offersCommissions;
055        
056        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
057                
058                this.dialog = dialog;
059                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
060                
061                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
062                if (command == null) return false;
063                
064                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
065                
066                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
067                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
068                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
069                
070                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
071                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
072                
073                playerFaction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
074                entityFaction = entity.getFaction();
075                
076                person = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
077                faction = person.getFaction();
078                
079                offersCommissions = faction.getCustomBoolean("offersCommissions");
080                
081                
082                //printInfo
083                //accept
084                
085                if (command.equals("printRequirements")) {
086                        printRequirements();
087                } else if (command.equals("playerMeetsCriteria")) {
088                        return playerMeetsCriteria();
089                } else if (command.equals("printInfo")) {
090                        printInfo();
091                } else if (command.equals("hasFactionCommission")) {
092                        return hasFactionCommission();
093                } else if (command.equals("hasOtherCommission")) {
094                        if (hasOtherCommission()) {
095                                memory.set("$theOtherCommissionFaction", Misc.getCommissionFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle(), 0);
096                                memory.set("$otherCommissionFaction", Misc.getCommissionFaction().getPersonNamePrefix(), 0);
097                                return true;
098                        }
099                        return false;
100                } else if (command.equals("accept")) {
101                        accept();
102                } else if (command.equals("resign")) {
103                        resign(true, dialog);
104                } else if (command.equals("resignNoPenalty")) {
105                        resign(false, dialog);
106                } else if (command.equals("personCanGiveCommission")) {
107                        return personCanGiveCommission();
108                }
109                else if (command.equals("commissionFactionIsAtWarWith")) {
110                        if (hasOtherCommission()) {
111                                if (params.size() >= 1) {
112                                        String target_faction_id = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
113                                        FactionAPI target_faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(target_faction_id);
114                                        if(target_faction != null )
115                                        {
116                                                return Misc.getCommissionFaction().isHostileTo(target_faction);
117                                        }
118                                }
119                        }
120                        return false;
121                }
122                else if (command.equals("isCargoPodsScam")) {
123                        MarketAPI market = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket();
124                        if(market == null) 
125                                return false;
126                        //Misc.getStorage(market)
127                        for (SectorEntityToken entity : market.getContainingLocation().getAllEntities()) {
128                                if (Entities.CARGO_PODS.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType())) {
129                                        
130                                        // use player fleet 'cause it's in market range, right? And therefore scan range.
131                                        // market is otherwise attached to a station or planet entity (who knows!)
132                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(entity.getLocation(), playerFleet.getLocation()); 
133                                        if( dist < 500f)
134                                                if (entity.getCargo().getSupplies() >= 10)
135                                                {
136                                                        return true;
137                                                }
138                                                        
139                                }
140                        }
141                        return false;
142                }
143                else if (command.equals("recalcFreeSupplyDaysRemaining")) {
144                        Object obj1 = person.getFaction().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get("$playerReceivedCommissionResupplyOn");
145                        Object obj2 = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get("$daysSinceStart"); 
146                        if(obj1 == null) return false;
147                        if(obj2 == null) return false;
148
149                        float d1 = (Float) obj1;
150                        float d2 = (Float) obj2;
151                        
152                        faction.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$daysLeft", (int)d1 + 365 - (int)d2 , 0);
153                }
154                else if (command.equals("doesPlayerFleetNeedRepairs")) {
155        
156                        
157                        float fleetCRcurrent = 0f;
158                        float fleetCRmax = 0f;
159                        float fleetHullDamage = 0f;
160
161                        //playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()
162                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerFleet.getMembersWithFightersCopy()) {
163                                if(member.isFighterWing()) continue; // no one cares about fighters.
164                                
165                                //if (member.canBeRepaired()) {
166                                fleetHullDamage += 1f - member.getStatus().getHullFraction();
167                                fleetCRcurrent += member.getRepairTracker().getCR();
168                                fleetCRmax += member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR();
169
170                        }
171                        
172
173                        //System.out.println("doesPlayerFleetNeedRepairs results:");
174                        //System.out.println("fleetCRcurrent = " + fleetCRcurrent);
175                        //System.out.println("fleetCRmax = " + fleetCRmax);
176                        //System.out.println("fleetHullDamage = " + fleetHullDamage); // ever 1f is about 100% of a ship
177                        
178                        boolean needsSupplies = false;
179                        
180                        if(fleetHullDamage > 0.5) {
181                                needsSupplies = true;
182                                
183                                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$fleetDamaged", true , 0);
184                                //memory.set("$fleetDamaged", true , 0); // "Looks like you've taken some damage."
185                        }
186                        
187                        if(fleetHullDamage > 2.5) {
188                                needsSupplies = true;
189                                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$fleetDamagedLots", true , 0); // "Your fleet is in rough shape, captain."
190                        }
191                        
192
193                        // basically, if the CR percent is less than 60% (of max) for the fleet, acknowledge that supplies are needed.
194                        if(fleetCRcurrent == 0 || (fleetCRcurrent / fleetCRmax < 0.6f) ) {
195                                needsSupplies = true;
196                                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$fleetLowCR", true , 0);
197                        }
198                        
199                        //memory.set("$fleetLowCR", true , 0);
200                        //memory.set("$fleetDamaged", true , 0);
201                        //memory.set("$fleetDamagedLots", true , 0);
202                        
203                        return needsSupplies;
204                }
205                
206                return true;
207        }
208
209        protected boolean hasFactionCommission() {
210                return faction.getId().equals(Misc.getCommissionFactionId());
211        }
212        protected boolean hasOtherCommission() {
213                return Misc.getCommissionFactionId() != null && !hasFactionCommission();
214        }
215        
216        
217        protected boolean personCanGiveCommission() {
218                if (person == null || !offersCommissions) return false;
219                if (person.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) return false;
220                
221                //if (Misc.getCommissionFactionId() != null) return false;
222                
223                return Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
224                           Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
225                           Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
226                           Ranks.POST_OUTPOST_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId());
227        }
228        
229        public static void resign(boolean withPenalty, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
230                FactionCommissionIntel intel = Misc.getCommissionIntel();
231                if (intel != null) {
232                        MissionResult result = intel.createResignedCommissionResult(withPenalty, true, dialog);
233                        intel.setMissionResult(result);
234                        intel.setMissionState(MissionState.ABANDONED);
235                        intel.endMission(dialog);
236                }
237        }
238        
239        protected void accept() {
240                if (Misc.getCommissionFactionId() == null) {
241                        FactionCommissionIntel intel = new FactionCommissionIntel(faction);
242                        intel.missionAccepted();
243                        intel.sendUpdate(FactionCommissionIntel.UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED, dialog.getTextPanel());
244                        intel.makeRepChanges(dialog);
245                }
246        }
247        
248        protected void printInfo() {
249                TooltipMakerAPI info = dialog.getTextPanel().beginTooltip();
250                
251                FactionCommissionIntel temp = new FactionCommissionIntel(faction);
252                
253                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
254                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
255                float pad = 3f;
256                float opad = 10f;
257                
258                info.setParaSmallInsignia();
259
260                int stipend = (int) temp.computeStipend();
261                
262                info.addPara("At your experience level, you would receive a %s monthly stipend, as well as a modest bounty for destroying enemy ships.",
263                                0f, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(stipend));
264                
265                List<FactionAPI> hostile = temp.getHostileFactions();
266                if (hostile.isEmpty()) {
267                        info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle()) + " is not currently hostile to any major factions.", 0f);
268                } else {
269                        info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle()) + " is currently hostile to:", opad);
270                        
271                        info.setParaFontDefault();
272                        
273                        info.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT);
274                        float initPad = opad;
275                        for (FactionAPI other : hostile) {
276                                info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(other.getDisplayName()), other.getBaseUIColor(), initPad);
277                                initPad = 3f;
278                        }
279                        info.setBulletedListMode(null);
280                }
281                
282                
283                dialog.getTextPanel().addTooltip();
284        }
285        
286        
287        protected boolean playerMeetsCriteria() {
288                return faction.getRelToPlayer().isAtWorst(COMMISSION_REQ);
289        }
290        protected void printRequirements() {
291                CoreReputationPlugin.addRequiredStanding(entityFaction, COMMISSION_REQ, null, dialog.getTextPanel(), null, null, 0f, true);
292                CoreReputationPlugin.addCurrentStanding(entityFaction, null, dialog.getTextPanel(), null, null, 0f);
293        }
294        
295        
296        
297}
